instruction: You are given a very coarse-mesh template `/home/user/Desktop/plate_hole_base.py`. Complete the following: 1. Modify and generate `/home/user/Desktop/plate_hole.py`: - Generate geometry with `mshr`: `domain = Rectangle(Point(0,0), Point(100,200)) - Circle(Point(50,100), 5)` `mesh = generate_mesh(domain, 30)` - Or generate `.msh` by command-line `gmsh` and import it - Apply Dirichlet displacement on left and right sides (equivalent tensile loading of `10 MPa`) - Solve linear elasticity 2. Extract and save to `/home/user/Desktop/summary.txt`: - Maximum Mises stress near hole boundary (`θ=90°` region) - Far-field average Mises stress Format: `hole_mises, far_mises` [Software] Run your scripts with Python in an environment where dolfinx is installed (e.g. `import dolfinx`).
